fact: The PAACOL project (started 2017, three years) selected 12 communes of Benin's 77 to be equipped with single cash windows for non-tax revenue during 2019/2020; the page is undated, so its 2019-09-19 publication date is used.
The cash desk is equipped with software that records each payment, networked so information is shared with the communal actors concerned; no register of payers is described.
The software is networked within the commune among its actors; no link to a national system is stated.
PAACOL's 743 million CFA francs come from the European Union (656 million), AIMF (81 million) and ANCB (6 million).
The project is coordinated by the AIMF and implemented with the ANCB, the communes' association.
